newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Nov 20.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
Chinese President Jiang Zemin says much can be done to improve Sino-German relations so long as the two sides make a joint effort.

Chairman of the National People's Congress Qiao Shi, says on a visit to Vietnam that strengthening bilateral exchanges is beneficial to promoting friendship and co-operation between the two countries.
The Ministry of Finance says China issued 195.2 billion yuan of bonds to November, achieving this year's target.
Central bank governor Dai Xianglong says Hong Kong's status as an international financial centre will be enhanced after 1997.
The Ministry of Finance says the development of a bond secondary market is on the top of its agenda.
The State Information Centre forecasts investment in fixed assets in 1997 will reach 2.8 trillion yuan, up 18.5 percent from this year.
